title: Advancements in stress-testing methodologies for financial stability applications
summary: This ECB Occasional Paper Series provides an overview of stress-testing methodologies in Europe, covering work by the ECB Financial Stability Committee Working Group on Stress Testing (WGST) from 2018 to 2022. The paper details the development of 16 new models, improvement of 5 existing models, and integration of 13 new datasets to enhance top-down, macro-micro, and system-wide stress-testing frameworks for assessing bank solvency, credit risk, market risk, and financial contagion.
key_points: The WGST (2018-2022) developed 16 new stress-testing models, with 5 replacing earlier STAMP€ models and 11 covering new areas
13 new datasets were integrated, including transaction-level data, to support enhanced stress-testing applications
Top-down models focus on credit risk (IFRS 9 and regulatory parameters), market risk, and profitability analysis
System-wide models (e.g., ISA model) capture interconnectedness among banks and non-banking financial institutions for contagion analysis
The WGST expanded stress-testing use beyond risk assessment to policy evaluation and communication applications
The paper discusses macroprudential stress testing including the BEAST model and approaches to incorporating climate and cyber risks
